challenge.pvz.brain_eating_movement.msg2: A zombie uprising broke out in the capital of our Abyss Dynasty last night,
challenge.pvz.brain_eating_movement.msg3: demanding the right for common zombies to travel to the surface.
challenge.pvz.brain_eating_movement.msg4: If surface passage is wrested from the nobles,
challenge.pvz.brain_eating_movement.msg5: brain-eating will become far easier for the zombies of the Abyss.
challenge.pvz.brain_eating_movement.name: Newspaper (Extra: The Brain-Eating Movement)
challenge.pvz.coffin.name: Coffin
challenge.pvz.column.name: Overwhelming
challenge.pvz.dance.msg1: A new hit from the zombie world today,
challenge.pvz.dance.name: Dance Party
challenge.pvz.game_over.msg2: "Curtain Call" is the longest opera in our theatre's history.
challenge.pvz.game_over.msg3: If something urgent arises and you must leave mid-performance,
challenge.pvz.game_over.msg4: the front desk will refund your ticket in proportion to the time remaining.
challenge.pvz.game_over.msg5: After the show, please leave in an orderly fashion.
challenge.pvz.game_over.name: Notice
challenge.pvz.grass_add.name: Extra Lawn
challenge.pvz.grass_day.msg3: we are about to launch an all-out assault
challenge.pvz.grass_day.name: Day Lawn
challenge.pvz.grass_night.msg3: we would love to drop by your place for a midnight snack.
challenge.pvz.grass_night.msg4: How does ice cream with brains sound?
challenge.pvz.grass_night.name: Night Lawn
challenge.pvz.gym.name: Gym
challenge.pvz.halloween.msg3: No matter, brains will do just as well
challenge.pvz.halloween.name: Halloween Challenge
challenge.pvz.jump_jump_jump.name: Jump! Jump! Jump!
challenge.pvz.mushroom_garden.msg1: The zombies invaded your mushroom garden in force during the night,
challenge.pvz.mushroom_garden.msg2: and now they are going to stew brains with mushrooms.
challenge.pvz.mushroom_garden.name: Night Mushroom Garden
challenge.pvz.newspaper.msg2: The King's dearly beloved brother has passed away
challenge.pvz.newspaper.msg3: As a member of the royal family, the King grants a special farewell rite
challenge.pvz.newspaper.msg4: So long as four zombies carry the coffin along the way,
challenge.pvz.newspaper.msg5: he may earn a chance of rebirth in another world
challenge.pvz.newspaper.name: Newspaper (Extra: The Prince's Passing)
challenge.pvz.origin_flame.msg1: Today the Abyss Zombie City sends out its elite Red Blade squad
challenge.pvz.origin_flame.msg2: to hunt down Dave and his companions.
challenge.pvz.origin_flame.msg3: If they succeed, the zombies of our city will feast on brains unhindered
challenge.pvz.origin_flame.msg4: At the squad's request, this operation is named "Operation Origin"
challenge.pvz.origin_flame.name: Operation Origin
challenge.pvz.pool_add.name: Extra Pool
challenge.pvz.pool_day.msg2: we heard you are throwing a pool party,
challenge.pvz.pool_day.msg3: and we are sure it must be great fun,
challenge.pvz.pool_day.msg4: so we will be right there
challenge.pvz.pool_day.name: Day Pool
challenge.pvz.pool_night.msg4: take down the defences on the lawn,
challenge.pvz.pool_night.msg5: and come try some meat wraps
challenge.pvz.pool_night.name: Night Pool
challenge.pvz.roof_again.msg3: I told you I would be back!
challenge.pvz.roof_again.name: Roof Revenge
challenge.pvz.roof_day.msg3: we are preparing to launch another all-out assault
challenge.pvz.roof_day.name: Day Roof
challenge.pvz.roof_extra.msg3: those routed zombies are regrouping with other units on the roof,
challenge.pvz.roof_extra.name: Extra Roof
challenge.pvz.roof_night.msg2: you still have not met our righteous demands.
challenge.pvz.roof_night.msg3: We suggest you take our sincere advice,
challenge.pvz.roof_night.msg4: otherwise we will be forced to take extraordinary action.
challenge.pvz.roof_night.msg5: Hand over your house and everything in it at once!
challenge.pvz.roof_night.name: Night Roof
challenge.pvz.sharp_edge.msg1: Today the plant positions were attacked by the Red Blade squad,
challenge.pvz.sharp_edge.msg5: but the plant forces fought back, found a breakthrough, and are about to break out.
challenge.pvz.sharp_edge.name: Shredding Blades
challenge.pvz.steel_and_fire.msg3: The air around begins to grow hot and dry
challenge.pvz.steel_and_fire.name: Steel and Fire
challenge.pvz.strange_help.msg2: When the zombies appear, do not be afraid
challenge.pvz.strange_help.msg3: You only need to stand there quietly
challenge.pvz.strange_help.msg4: and silently wait for the zombies to approach
challenge.pvz.strange_help.msg5: When the zombies eat your brain, you win!
challenge.pvz.strange_help.msg6: --This part of the help is a gift from the zombies--
challenge.pvz.strange_help.name: Strange Help
challenge.pvz.surrounded.msg3: Have you, all by yourself, surrounded us?
challenge.pvz.surrounded.name: Surrounded
challenge.pvz.title: Challenge
challenge.pvz.too_far_away: You are too far from the challenge
challenge.pvz.zombie_barracks.msg2: When the moon rises to the treetops of the Wall-nuts,
challenge.pvz.zombie_barracks.msg3: wait beneath the red mushroom tree by the river.
challenge.pvz.zombie_barracks.msg4: This message is relayed by an Imp,
challenge.pvz.zombie_barracks.msg5: so mind whether the area around you is safe.
challenge.pvz.zombie_barracks.name: Zombie Army
challenge.pvz.zombie_boss_twins.msg3: ...I do not think anything more needs to be said.
challenge.pvz.zombie_boss_twins.name: Double Revenge
challenge.pvz.zombie_is_coming.msg2: The Prince's coffin is expected to arrive tonight,
challenge.pvz.zombie_is_coming.msg3: and word of his successful rebirth will be sent back.
challenge.pvz.zombie_is_coming.msg4: The surface entrance will then reopen,
challenge.pvz.zombie_is_coming.msg5: so let us wish the Prince and his retinue every success.
challenge.pvz.zombie_is_coming.name: Newspaper (Headline: The Prince Arrives)
